name: AI Object Visualizer backend
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libgl1 libglib2.0-0 && pip install --no-cache-dir torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/aiobject && (pkill -f 'python app.py' || true) && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=5000 nohup python app.py > /tmp/aiobject.log 2>&1 &
